messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need a lightweight SEV flow for marketplace partners that uses a dual-bridge (vendor + Redwood) with explicit handback steps. low-friction for QAs and SIs, but still auditable.

kev: +1. do we want a single shared channel per partner or ephemeral warrooms per incident?

sophie: Ephemeral warrooms for SEV1/2, shared channel for operational comms & onboarding docs. keeps noise down. :white_check_mark:

raj: Proposal: naming convention `#partner-<vendor>-sev-<yyyymmdd>-<id>` for warrooms, and `#partner-<vendor>-ops` as persistent channel. automation spawns the sev channel and pings both sides.

marisol: Practical ask from HW partners — phone fallback is mandatory for SEV1. We should capture phone numbers and escalation tree in the warroom header.

maya: Agreed. Also need a minimal runbook snippet (first 15 mins) in the warroom header: triage owner, impact, known workarounds, oncall contact.

kev: rough header template:

```
Warroom: #partner-nimbus-sev-20241101-01
Severity: SEV1
Redwood Triage: @maya
Partner Triage: @marisol
Phone fallback: +1-555-410-7890 (Marisol)
Initial checklist: confirm impact -> collect logs -> enable read-only fallback
```

raj: For automation, alerts-bot should create the warroom when we hit the SEV threshold. Suggested rule: if partner SLA is < 2h, create warroom automatically on page.

alerts-bot: auto-create rule applied for vendor:supported_marketplace AND severity:SEV1 -> spawn_channel; ping @oncall-bot and partner liaison.

marisol: Can we also include a short permissions matrix in the warroom header so partners know who can comment vs just view? helps with sensitive logs.

sophie: Yes — include "ReadOnly" and "FullOps" tags. Default partner liaison = FullOps for their people.

maya: Ops handback flow idea: 1) partner confirms fix in their env, 2) Redwood runs validation script (2 commands), 3) partner ACKs, 4) close warroom and copy postmortem link to partner-ops channel.

kev: validation script snippet to run in warroom:

```
./validate_integration --partner nimbus --smoke --samples 100
curl -sS https://status.redwood.ai/validate?token=$TOKEN
```

raj: action items: automation team builds warroom spawn + header template, bizdev collects phone & escalation contacts, security signs off on log access matrix.

marisol: I'll gather partner contacts and confirm phone fallback by EOD Friday. tagging @sophie for channel perms config.

maya: thanks — let's run a partner triage sim next Tues. scope: marketplace launch partners + one SI. short postmortem and tweak template. :rocket:

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled simulation run on 2024-11-12 15:00 UTC — will page oncall rotation and create ephemeral channels.

kev: perfect. marking in calendar. anyone want to lead the sim?

sophie: i'll lead the sim and act as incident commander for the Redwood side.

maya: perfect — closing here. will post the finalized header + automation spec in #partnerships later today.
